items.title: Saboeiro (CE) Services procurement · pre-qualification · closes Nov 21 #PQ028
items.en_title: Saboeiro (CE) Services procurement · pre-qualification · closes Nov 21 #PQ028
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Saboeiro (CE) is procuring professional or outsourced services through pre-qualification, with an estimated value of about R$ 1.71; proposals close Nov 21, 07:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
